$comment: Canonical branch protection ruleset for SkDD-conformant repos. Applied by `logmind init --configure-github`, `clud-bug init --configure-github`, and `reporulez`. Implements thrillmade/protocol SPEC §7. Schema-locked at v1; major bumps require coordinated tool releases.

$notes.required_approving_review_count: 1 — auto-satisfied by clud-bug[bot]'s APPROVE vote on clean reviews for org-member PRs (per SPEC §7.2.1). External-contributor PRs still need a human reviewer because the bot's APPROVE on first-time contributors is policy-gated. Repo-owners MAY raise above 1; tools MUST NOT lower below 1.
$notes.enforce_admins: false so maintainers can land hotfixes outside the gate; the dogfood discipline expects this only for genuine emergencies (clud-bug review still runs but doesn't block)
$notes.contexts: the four logmind workflow check names + clud-bug-review + a generic 'tests' context. Repos may add more, but MUST keep these. If a context name is renamed in workflow YAML, update the ruleset.
$notes.required_conversation_resolution: true is the dogfood-defining rule: clud-bug findings must be resolved before merge
